species.name: Striped bass
why: Water 61°F on top, a bit cool for them, so they feed in the warmest water they can find.
Best water today is 18–22 ft deep, mostly on wind-blown banks.
The lake is layered: warm water down to about 45 ft, cold below.
Little oxygen below about 65 ft, so fish stay above it.
Southwest wind at 21 mph pushes bait onto the northeast shore: try the wind-blown banks.
